html:
The Bay Miwok were a Miwok people of the eastern San Francisco Bay Area, in what is now Contra Costa County, California, from the Carquinez Strait and the delta south to the Mount Diablo hills.

They lived in small independent groups, such as the Saclan and the Chupcan, and gathered acorns and seeds, fished and hunted. From the 1790s most were taken into the missions at San Francisco and San José, and the Saclan took part in a revolt and escape in 1795. Their language died out. Neighbours included the Karkin, the Chochenyo Ohlone and the Plains Miwok.
